excerpt.zh: GPT-6.1 Terra 的发布页在 Hacker News 获得大量讨论，但现有来源未提供模型功能、性能或可用性细节。
excerpt.en: GPT-6.1 Terra drew strong Hacker News engagement, but the available source provides no details on its features, performance, or availability.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Terra 是一则指向 OpenAI 发布页的模型相关消息。所提供的资料显示，该故事于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布在 Hacker News，获得 497 分和 314 条评论，表明它在该社区引起了显著关注。
text.en: GPT-6.1 Terra is a model-related story linking to an OpenAI launch page. The supplied metadata says it appeared on Hacker News on October 26, 2026, where it received 497 points and 314 comments, indicating substantial attention from that community.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Terra：关注度不等于产品信息
text.en: GPT-6.1 Terra: attention is not product detail

text.zh: 不过，现有来源没有提供原始文章正文，只有标题、链接和互动数据。因此，这些数字能够说明读者参与度，却不能证实模型的具体能力、技术变化、适用场景或与其他系统的比较。
text.en: However, the original article text is unavailable in the supplied context, which contains only a title, link, and engagement figures. Those figures show reader participation; they do not establish the model’s capabilities, technical changes, intended uses, or how it compares with other systems.

text.zh: 在获得发布页正文或其他可核实的产品资料前，不宜把这次讨论解读为对性能提升或产品已开放的证明。关键问题仍包括：Terra 指什么、它与 GPT-6.1 的关系是什么，以及产品是否已经可用。当前能确定的重点是社区关注度，而不是模型的实际表现。
text.en: Until the launch page or other verifiable product information is available, this discussion should not be treated as proof of better performance or public availability. Key questions remain: what “Terra” refers to, how it relates to GPT-6.1, and whether the product is available. For now, the clearest takeaway is community interest, not evidence of the model’s real-world performance.
